name: @orchestrator-ai/shared-contracts-v2
description: Shared OpenAPI v2 contracts and generation scripts.

scripts.generate:py:
echo 'Generating Python models...' && mkdir -p contracts/generated/python && datamodel-codegen --input contracts/common-types.yaml --output contracts/generated/python/common_types.py --target-python-version 3.11 && datamodel-codegen --input contracts/a2a-protocol.yaml --output contracts/generated/python/a2a_protocol.py --target-python-version 3.11 && datamodel-codegen --input contracts/mcp-types.yaml --output contracts/generated/python/mcp_types.py --target-python-version 3.11 && datamodel-codegen --input contracts/session-types.yaml --output contracts/generated/python/session_types.py --target-python-version 3.11 && datamodel-codegen --input contracts/auth-types.yaml --output contracts/generated/python/auth_types.py --target-python-version 3.11 && echo 'Generating task store types with proper imports...' && echo 'from __future__ import annotations

from typing import List, Optional

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

# Import shared types from a2a_protocol
from .a2a_protocol import Task, Message


class TaskConversation(BaseModel):
    """
    Conversation history for a task (V2 extension)
    """

    task_id: str = Field(..., description="Associated task ID")
    messages: List[Message] = Field(default=[], description="Conversation messages")
    session_id: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Optional session ID")


class TaskAndHistory(BaseModel):
    """
    Task with conversation history wrapper
    """

    task: Task
    conversation: Optional[TaskConversation] = None' > contracts/generated/python/task_store_types.py && echo 'Fixing Pydantic v2 compatibility...' && python3 fix-pydantic-v2.py && echo '✅ Python generation complete with Pydantic v2 fixes!'
scripts.fix:pydantic-v2: echo 'Fixing Pydantic v2 compatibility...' && python3 fix-pydantic-v2.py
scripts.generate: npm run generate:ts && npm run generate:py
scripts.lint:contracts: redocly lint contracts/common-types.yaml && redocly lint contracts/a2a-protocol.yaml && redocly lint contracts/mcp-types.yaml && redocly lint contracts/session-types.yaml && redocly lint contracts/auth-types.yaml && redocly lint contracts/task-store-types.yaml
